answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 46683 Country: India Title: use of eye drops during roza Question: Regular use of eye drops round the year is necessary for treatment of eye ailment; therefore can it be used during roza also without affecting roza in ramzan. Answer ID: 46683 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1203/927/B=9/1434) Roza (fast) does not break (nullify) by administering eye drop in the eyes whether it is used occasionally or at daily basis. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
